title: Show a web page in a dockable panel
summary: Hosts a Microsoft Edge WebView2 browser (the copy Altium Designer ships) in a dockable extension panel, opens the panel from a command and navigates to an http(s) address.
phrasings: embed a web browser in an extension panel
open a URL inside Altium Designer
use WebView2 in a dockable panel
host a WinForms control in a panel

commands.name: NavigateToURL
commands.description: Load a web address in the Web Browser panel and show it

commands.name: GetBrowserState
commands.description: Report the Web Browser panel's address, page title and last navigation result (added read-back for tests)
